correctness.rationale: The standard marked-cluster generating function F_w(z,y)=C_w(z,y)/[(1-z(q-1+y))C_w(z,y)+z^m y^{h_w}] is a formal series with invertible denominator. Setting y=1 gives H_w-H_v=z^m(C0_w-C0_v)/(D_w D_v), so equality of all N(n), 0<=n<=2m-1, makes the degree<=m-1 polynomial C0_w-C0_v identically zero. Differentiating the reciprocal at y=1 then makes J_w-J_v proportional to z^m[(h_w-h_v)C0-(C1_w-C1_v)]/C0²; the same coefficient window forces this polynomial zero, its constant gives h_w=h_v and all marked overlap derivatives C1 agree. At each overlapping d, C0 stores the existence indicator and C1 the exact marked-letter suffix count, hence complete weighted border polynomials match, giving every histogram A_w(n,k). The binary witness w_m=0110^(m-3), v_m=10^(m-2)1 for m>=4 has C0=1+z^(m-1), equal h=2, and first J difference coefficient at 2m-1, proving cutoff sharp. Independently enumerated all binary words for m=4, n<=7: w=0110, v=1001, N7=97 each, M7=340 and339; grouped all forbidden words m<=4 against finite jets and complete checked histograms. Two forbidden-set witness {00,11} vs {01,10} has same N,M all n but different spectra at n=2. Finite enumeration corroborates the formal proof only.
